class.name: SteamLobbyOperation
class.brief_description: Cancellable observation of one standalone Steam lobby create or join.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether this operation has a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Await [signal completed] or return its existing [SteamLobbyResult] if already finished.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Settle the pending observation with [constant ERR_SKIP]. An acquired membership is cleaned up once the pending native Steam call completes. An already settled operation returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once when the lobby is available or the observation fails, is cancelled, or reaches its 30-second deadline.
